name: 岚鸟
habitat: 洛克王国世界：野外捕捉（天空组）；雪绒鸟进化链
habitatEn: Roco Kingdom: World — wild capture (Sky group); evolves from Xuerongniao
evolution: 雪绒鸟 → 冬羽雀（Lv.5）→ 岚鸟（Lv.30）→ 霜翼领主
description: 岚鸟是洛克王国世界中的翼系精灵，由雪绒鸟经冬羽雀30级进化而来，可再进化为霜翼领主。特性'顺风'先手攻击时技能威力+50%，高速物理输出，绅士气质颇有人气。
descriptionEn: A Flying-type spirit in Roco Kingdom: World, evolved from Xuerongniao via Dongyuque at Lv.30, further into Frostwing Lord. Trait 'Tailwind' gives +50% power when attacking first; high-Speed physical attacker.

skills.name: 扇风
skills.description: 造成物伤，若先于敌方攻击，本次技能威力+50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Physical damage; +50% power if attacking first.

skills.name: 闪击
skills.description: 造成物伤，速度比敌方越高，本次技能威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Physical damage; more Speed advantage = more power.

skills.name: 俯冲猛击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。

skills.name: 龙卷风
skills.description: 造成物伤，迅捷，应对状态：本次技能威力变为1.5倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Physical damage; Swift; vs status: power x1.5.
